payout_quote: Our Refer a Friend program allows eligible clients to earn USD 200 for each friend they refer to IBKR... You will receive USD 200 for each referred friend who: Opens an individual or joint account using your unique referral link; Deposits at least USD 10,000 (or equivalent) within 30 days; Maintains a balance of at least USD 10,000 (or equivalent) for 1 year. (Official Interactive Brokers referral page)
timing: Paid after the referred friend meets all conditions including the 1-year balance maintenance
eligibility: Referrer must be an IBKR client with an individual or joint account, account net liquidation value of at least USD 2,000, and at least one securities trade placed; friend must open via your unique link; tax-deferred accounts ineligible; several countries excluded
steps: Open and fund your own IBKR individual or joint account ($2,000+ value) and place at least one trade
Generate your unique referral link in the IBKR portal
Share it with a friend who genuinely wants a brokerage account
Friend opens an individual/joint account via your link, deposits $10,000+ within 30 days, and maintains $10,000+ for 1 year
You receive USD 200 per qualifying friend (up to 15 per calendar year, 30 total)
catches: HIGH BAR: your friend must deposit at least $10,000 within 30 days AND keep $10,000+ in the account for a full year - most people you know won't qualify
You don't get paid until the 1-year maintenance is complete
You must already be an IBKR client with $2,000+ in the account and at least one trade to refer anyone
Capped at 15 referrals per calendar year and 30 total - not unlimited
Tax-deferred (IRA) accounts don't count for either side
Residents of Japan, Denmark, Spain, Portugal, Poland, mainland China and Israel are ineligible
Only refer people who genuinely want IBKR - manufacturing referrals or coaching friends to game the deposit would violate the program terms
biggest_catch: Your friend must park $10,000 for a full year before you see a cent - this only pays if you know serious investors, and you're capped at 15 referrals a year.
